## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-a2a-census`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-a2a-census -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `a2a_census.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `a2a_atoms.json`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `a2a_census.json`
- `a2a_census.jsonl`
- `ledger-card-a2a-agent-unsigned.json`

**Independent measurement of A2A agent-card endpoints. Not a certification.**

- Verify any card free: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/ · Catalog: https://councilof.ai/catalog.json · Methodology: https://councilof.ai/methodology/
- Live board: https://councilof.ai/api/gspc (read counts live; none are typed here)

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/a2a-census at revision `868571083fa6544558a62e2cb99ba8bd8ba18a97`, made 2026-10-06. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# A2A agent census

DISCOVERED — read-only census of A2A (Agent2Agent) agent cards. Keyless crawl of `/.well-known/agent-card.json` + A2A v1.0 conformance + ONE controlled deterministic capability probe per agent. No real task was ever sent to a stranger agent; nothing published. The live board is `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`. [![GSPC](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcouncilof.ai%2Fapi%2Fgspc&query=%24.totals.public_count&label=GSPC&color=0B1F33)](https://councilof.ai/gspc-scoreboard)

**Defensible seed list:** the agent domains discovered genuinely on-chain-live in the
ERC-8004 live-filter (their declared service endpoints), plus a curated set of well-known
A2A domains. We fetched `/.well-known/agent-card.json` (legacy `agent.json` fallback),
checked it against the A2A **v1.0 AgentCard** shape (frozen Mar 2026), and ran one probe.

## Result (`a2a_census.json`)

- **18 seeds crawled.** Only **5 serve a conformant AgentCard**; 13 serve no card
  (many return an HTML lander at the well-known path). *Most on-chain-"live" agents do
  not publish a conformant A2A card.*
- **Capability-honesty axis** — ONE deterministic probe I control: a JSON-RPC
  `tasks/get` with a random nonexistent id (read-only; asks the agent to do no real work,
  triggers no payment). Graded declared-vs-actual **transport**:
  - `TRANSPORT_HONEST` — declares A2A JSON-RPC and answered with a well-formed JSON-RPC
    envelope (e.g. A-Identity Trust Oracle, Brain On BNB).
  - `TRANSPORT_MISMATCH` — declares an A2A card but the transport did not answer JSON-RPC
    correctly (a real declared-vs-actual gap).

## Reported context (cited, not endorsed, not A2A-specific)

Carnegie Mellon **TheAgentCompany** benchmark (arXiv:2412.14161, May 2025) reported the
worst model (Llama-3.1-405b) failed **92.6%** of real-world office tasks; the best
(Gemini 2.5 Pro) still failed 70%. This is a general agent-task-completion benchmark,
**not** an A2A-protocol measurement — cited to motivate measuring declared-vs-actual
capability. https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.14161

## Files

- `a2a_census.jsonl` — flat viewer table, one row per crawled seed (18): `agent_name`,
  `domain`, `seed`, `card_state` (CONFORMANT/NO_CARD), `capability_honesty_verdict`,
  `skill_count`, `as_of`. Field-presence lists live in `a2a_census.json`, not this table.
- `a2a_census.json` — per-seed card URL, conformance, field presence, honesty probe verdict.
- `a2a_atoms.json` — the unique conformant agents with their honesty verdict.
- `ledger-card-a2a-agent-unsigned.json` — the `a2a.agent` card-v0 atom
  (`sig_ed25519=null` — NO_LAPTOP_SIGN, queued for GHA OIDC signing).

## What this is not

- No real A2A task was sent — only one controlled protocol-level probe per agent.
- Skill **execution correctness** is `unmeasured[]`. Streaming/push actuals unmeasured.
- Not a GSPC axis. No GSPC measure fields on any card.

**Measurement, not certification.** Verify a card (free, no account): https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify

## Dataset facts (checked 2026-11-20)

- Kaggle version 5, last updated 2026-10-06.
- 6 files, 34,541 bytes. File types: .json (3), .jsonl (2), .md (1).
- Hugging Face twin: [csoai/a2a-census](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/a2a-census). 5 of 6 files have the same byte size there.
- Expected update frequency: never.
